facts.text: Snow left Mount Crag (3,960 ft) and Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) 24 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 5 (2024), June 9 (2025)

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 13 (2024), June 15 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Mount Crag (3,960 ft) and Buckinghorse (4,850 ft).

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: 14.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 43.4 in (2023), 22.0 in (2024), 36.7 in (2025)
